morningCanvasRoi.label: Morning canvas ROI
morningCanvasRoi.note: Structured morning hours 08–15 → canvas capacity with log1p diminishing returns. 3–4h strong; packing all 7 not much better.

idea.name: Morning canvas ROI
idea.mechanism: Pre-work window ~08:00–15:00 America/Chicago (7h open canvas before work 15:00–23:00). Input x = structured hours placed in the morning canvas (deep work / high-leverage), 0…7. Ideal y = yMax · log1p(x) / log1p(xMax) with xMax=7 — diminishing returns so 3–4h is strong; packing all 7 is not much better. v1 single curve (optional fragmentation penalty later). view.sample wires the same idealY(x); score = idealY/yMax.
idea.assumptions: Single continuous block quality ignored in v1; work starts 15:00; canvas open 08–15 America/Chicago

energy.label: Energy (burnout recovery→push)
energy.note: High-performer burnout cycle: morning recovery hours (games) restore push capacity; peak ~2h (08–10). Less = under-recovered into Work; more = avoidance that eats canvas. score = idealY/yMax.

idea.name: Energy burnout cycle
idea.mechanism: After Work 15–23, energy is depleted. Morning games 08–10 (~2h) restore energy for Grok/deep push 10–13. Ideal energy peaks at ~2 recovery hours then falls (avoidance debt). Work block stays high-load; this jmethod scores the recovery→push hinge.
idea.inputs: recovery hours in morning (0–4h); act.hours maps to x
idea.assumptions: Peak recovery 2h; width 2h to near-zero; DAFI/day rhythm America/Chicago; non-Money factors authored here (not nonfactor)

robinhoodGold.label: Robinhood Gold (edge vs fee)
robinhoodGold.note: Keep Gold only if expected gross monthly trading edge clears risk haircut (keep 55%) + $6 fee. Break-even gross edge ≈ $10.91/mo. EXAMPLE priors — VERIFY with real fills.

idea.name: Robinhood Gold worth
idea.mechanism: Gold costs $6/mo. Expected gross edge x ($/mo) is haircut for risk (keep 55%), then minus Gold. Net y=max(0, 0.55x−6). Score y/yMax. Day-trading benefit must clear ~$11 gross/mo before Gold is +EV.
idea.inputs: expected gross trading edge $/mo (0–50); place uses hours×$5 EXAMPLE edge prior
idea.assumptions: 55% risk keep fraction EXAMPLE; Gold $6; not tax-aware; VERIFY edge from real journal
